Initial release of veterinary clinic operations assistant.

- Optimizes appointment scheduling and reduces no-shows
- Automates client follow-up workflows (surgery, vaccination, wellness)
- Provides inventory tracking and reorder alerts for medications/supplies
- Generates end-of-day reports, revenue summaries, and retention metrics
- Includes ready-to-use client communication templates for common scenarios
- Not intended for medical diagnosis or controlled substance tracking
